import html # Pre‑defined HTML template for a blog post. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def render_article_page(headline: str, content: str) -> str: """ Render a blog post page by sanitizing user input and inserting it into the BLOG_FORMAT template. Parameters: headline (str): The title of the blog post. content (str): The full text content of the blog post. Returns: str: A safe, HTML‑formatted string ready for inclusion in a web page. Raises: TypeError: If either argument is not a string. """ if not isinstance(headline, str) or not isinstance(content, str): raise TypeError("headline and content must be strings") # Escape HTML special characters to prevent XSS (CWE‑79) safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Insert sanitized values into the template return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_headline, body=safe_content)
